## EA Media Tools 2.6.3 - jaguar

### HEVC Main10 control

- Main10 is now an independent Filters-tab switch instead of an HDR-to-SDR sub-option.
- Every capable HEVC encoder can use the override, regardless of preset or source format. Applying a preset still restores its automatic source-based default.
- NVIDIA SDR sources convert to CUDA-native `p010le` inside `scale_cuda`, preserving the zero-copy NVDEC-to-NVENC path and selecting the HEVC Main10 profile.

### Video timing and quality controls

- Streaming and Cellular expose their preset-driven 23.976 fps override in the Video tab; slower sources remain passthrough and faster sources default to exact `24000/1001` CFR.
- Streaming uses no multipass at 4K and quarter-resolution multipass at 1080p and below. Cellular uses quarter-resolution multipass at 360p.
- Encoded audio keeps timestamp-aware resampling when video frame rate is converted.

### Update reliability

- Packaged Windows starts and update installs recursively remove obsolete `app-<version>` directories, including partial directories containing only `app.asar`.
- Startup remains paused on the splash screen until an available update finishes downloading and the Restart/Later prompt is answered. Choosing Later resumes startup and installs on exit.

[Review changes since v2.6.2](https://github.com/eaforlife/media-converter/compare/v2.6.2...v2.6.3).
